title: Fosdem 2020 Call For Presentations
html:
The next FOSDEM edition (February 1-2, 2020) is hosting again a devroom for Real Time Communications.

You can see more details about the announcement at:

  • https://lists.kamailio.org/pipermail/sr-users/2019-October/107165.html

If you are interested to present on topics related to open source RTC, consider to submit a proposal via Pentabarf portal offered by FOSDEM organizers:

  • https://penta.fosdem.org/submission/FOSDEM20/

In Pentabarf system, on the “General” tab, look for the “Track” option and choose “Real Time Communications devroom”. The deadline is 23:59 UTC on the 15th of December, 2019.
